name: sandbox
notes: Public dual-runtime hobby/research repository. T1 permits reversible local work and scoped publishing. merge stays gated BY DECLARATION, and the rationale recorded here before 2026-07-27 was stale: it claimed the repository has no GitHub Actions workflow. It does -- .github/workflows/ci.yml runs a Release build plus the Category!=Performance suite on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest for pushes and pull requests to main. What survives as a gate rationale is narrower: main carries no branch-protection ruleset, so exact-head CI is process-enforced rather than required, and the headline performance objective is unmet with only reported-only Release evidence. Whether that still justifies gated merge, or whether this repo should take the estate default of merge free (agent-harness#91), is an owner decision -- an agent must not flip it. Claude uses the shared global PreToolUse floor. Codex uses the shared dispatcher through the repository-owned .codex/hooks.json adapter; that adapter is inactive until its exact definition is reviewed and trusted in a fresh Codex session via /hooks. No sensitive or production data is expected. human_todo is null because no human-only operational gate exists. The inert model_routing block was removed 2026-07-27 per SPECS: the model ladder lives only in BLUEPRINT/SPECS.
